text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a 30-minute walk each day makes a big difference. Third, get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Mental health is just as important, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Don't work all the time; enjoy hobbies and spend time with family and friends. Small healthy habits every day lead to a happier, longer life.
